turns.text: Hi, I need to change the delivery address. The parcel should not go to the address I used at checkout.
Please send your order number, the email you used at checkout, and the full new delivery address so I can check whether the address can be changed.
The order is SC-3360, the email is nora.blake@example.com, and the new address is Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu.

The address for SC-3360 hasn’t changed. The order has already shipped, and the shop can only change delivery addresses before shipping. I’ve handed this over to a colleague who will check what options are still available.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer nora.blake@example.com requests that SC-3360 not go to the checkout address and instead go to Str. Exemplu 22, Sibiu. Delivery-change policy check returned already_shipped; no change filed. Please review what options are available.
